verdict.rationale: Radar documents custom rules that request 3D Secure, for example for payments from new customers, and these rules can use supported risk attributes. Risk settings let you balance authorization against fraud, which covers the 'trigger 3DS when risky' half of the story. The evidence says nothing about SCA-specific handling of European traffic, so missing for 10: automatic 3DS when SCA regulation requires it, requesting SCA exemptions (TRA/low-value) on safe payments, EU-specific routing logic, conversion-impact evidence, and independent corroboration.
